grade: analytic (no RTL); reader terms measured-old-RTL (D) or rung-bound formula; area from closed tiles

query_store_bits.note: each NK 1 engine holds its query (hslice per head); 6 stores = 6 engines a region, or a changed engine with 6 query banks

engines.note: an unchanged NK 1 engine scores one query at 1 key/cycle -> 6 a region (0.71 duty at HBM rate, 0.5 on today's landing); 5 a region is the MAC floor but needs a query-switching engine

landing.today: 2 x 256-b reads a key on one PC macro -> 1 key / 2 cycles a region (8 keys/cycle/die < 11.35)
landing.b3_hbm_rate: 1 key/cycle a region needs a 544-b read: split each PC landing into 2 macros (code sectors in parallel) -> +2 ot_sram_1r1w_256x256 a region

egress.single_rung: 6 x N scores through 8/cycle = 6N/8 cycles = the same as 6 separate N/8 scans: no gain
egress.local_partial_topk: per-region top-512 for each query = 96 selectors a die (>= 96 x 0.121 mm2 = 11.6 mm2 + merge) and still 16 x 512 candidates a query: rejected

D_measured_reader.what: option D k=3 as recorded (measured W11 reader, HBM-bound 11.35 keys/cycle); scand.json by_k.3 check

D_rung_bound_reader.what: option D k=3 with the p4l reader now built (1 key / 2 cycles a region, one 276-b rung): scan N/8 + 600

B3_hbm_rate.what: B3 at the HBM rate: 544-b landing reads (1 key/cycle a region), 6 engines a region, egress >= 68 scores/cycle (12 rungs / 12 select quarters); scan shared by 6 positions (+320 q-chain cycles)

B3_six_rungs.what: B3 on today's landing (8 keys/cycle/die), 6 engines a region, 6 rungs -> 6 select quarters; scan N/8 + 600 shared by 6 positions

B3_single_rung.what: B3 on today's single rung: 6 queries x N scores through 8 scores/cycle -> 6N/8 + 600 shared

area.note: engines dominate: +80 NK 1 engines a die (6 a region).  Wires not priced: 6-12 x 276-b score chains through the 16 regions and into bk_sel; bk_sel multi-segment control (today single-segment) is RTL work.  x96 = only the dies of the duplicated full-scan groups (a die variant; owner prefers few die types).

recommendation.rule: AGENTS.md: adopt only if >= 1 % of per-user rate; owner 10-16 "only significant gains"; accepted-cost ledger <= 5 %/unit
recommendation.reason: B3 at the HBM rate gains MTP +2.83 % single-user (AR 0) for +47.7 mm2 a die (+5.97 % of 799 mm2, 24,803 mm2 over 520 dies), plus 12 score rungs and multi-segment bk_sel: over 1 % but not significant against ~6 % silicon and a 6x scorer the die does not have (vs the rung-bound reader B3 on 6 rungs is +4.26 % for 46.27 mm2).  B3 on today's single rung loses (6N/8 + 320: MTP 3430.2).  The larger, cheaper item is the 1-query reader itself: the rung-bound p4l reader loses AR -1.09 % / MTP -2.18 % against the measured-reader D -> make it reach the stack rate first (544-b landing read = +32 SRAM 256x256 = 0.23 mm2 a die, engine already 1 key/cycle, 2 rungs into 2 of bk_sel's 4 existing quarters + merge).
recommendation.upper_bound_caveat: the B3 wave rule assumes the 6 positions meet at each scan stage without re-serialising the post-scan work at every one of the 4 scan stages; that re-bunching is not modelled, so the B3 gain is an upper bound
